spans.s: अहुत (I) a. (f. ता) Not yet offered as an oblation.
अहुत (II) m. Religious meditation, prayer and study of the Veda (together called ब्रह्मयज्ञ) See M.iii.73, 74.
अहुत (I) a. (f. ता) Not yet offered as an oblation.
आहुति f. 1. Offering an oblation to a deity, होतुराहुतिसाधनम् R.i.82; 2. an oblation so offered, R.i.53.
